crossRefs.note: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.
Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.
So Yahweh sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.
Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.
A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.
How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has…
See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how…

people.name: Korah
people.line: Levite rebel leader; his descendants became temple servants

translations.web: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, in addition to those who died about the matter of Korah.
translations.bsb: But those who died from the plague numbered 14,700, in addition to those who had died on account of Korah.
translations.kjv: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
translations.asv: Now they that died by the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, besides them that died about the matter of Korah.
